uncited: - **Inputs**: Cloud type ID (9 for Cumulus, 10 for Cumulonimbus, or 1/7 for other layer clouds), `style_offset` (integer), `seed` (integer), `lobe_count` (integer, required for Cumulonimbus), random number generator state.
